SELECT TO_CHAR(E.BASIC_NO) AS BASIC_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(E.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_TYPE_CODE_NAME, E.COURSE_NAME_CODE, E.PERIOD_TIME, E.IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR, E.IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT, TO_CHAR(E.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(E.IMPLE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_END_DATE, E.TRAIN_CONTENT, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE C WHERE C.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND C.EVA_RESULT IS NOT NULL) AS STUDENT_EVAL_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM EDU_TRAIN_RESULT R WHERE R.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND (R.DIFFICULTY IS NOT NULL OR R.CONTENT_RICH IS NOT NULL OR R.PRACTICABILITY IS NOT NULL OR R.TIME_MODERATE IS NOT NULL)) AS RESULT_EVAL_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE F WHERE F.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND F.ACTIVITY = '1' AND F.CPNY_ID = E.CPNY_ID) AS STUDENT_COUNT, (SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(R.RESULT_NO)) FROM EDU_TRAIN_RESULT R WHERE R.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND R.STU_EMPID = #{empid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS RESULT_NO,
CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EDU_STUDENT_CHECK S WHERE S.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND S.ACTIVITY = '1' AND S.CPNY_ID = E.CPNY_ID AND S.TEA_PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IN_PROGRESS
CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EDU_TEACHER_CHECK T WHERE T.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND T.ACTIVITY = '1' AND T.CPNY_ID = E.CPNY_ID AND T.STU_EMPID = #{empid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND (T.ALLSCORE IS NOT NULL OR T.GROOMING IS NOT NULL)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IN_PROGRESS
CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EDU_TRAIN_RESULT R WHERE R.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND R.ACTIVITY = '1' AND R.CPNY_ID = E.CPNY_ID AND R.ALLSCORE IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IN_PROGRESS
FROM EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION E JOIN EDU_PLAN_MANAGER P ON P.PLAN_NO = E.PLAN_NO WHERE E.ACTIVITY = '1' AND E.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND INSTR(NVL(P.ISNOT_EVALUATE, '0'), #{evalType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
AND E.IMPLE_START_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND E.IMPLE_END_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND INSTR(',' || TO_CHAR(E.EVA_TEACHER_EMPID) || ',', ',' || #{empid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ',') > 0
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE F WHERE F.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND F.ACTIVITY = '1' AND F.CPNY_ID = E.CPNY_ID AND F.EMPID = #{empid, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
ORDER BY E.CREATE_DATE DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(R.RESULT_NO) AS RESULT_NO, R.BASIC_NO, R.STU_EMPID, R.STU_LOCAL_NAME, R.DIFFICULTY, R.CONTENT_RICH, R.PRACTICABILITY, R.TIME_MODERATE, R.ALLSCORE, R.OTHER_ADVISE FROM EDU_TRAIN_RESULT R WHERE R.BASIC_NO = #{basicNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND R.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND R.ACTIVITY = 1
AND (R.DIFFICULTY IS NOT NULL OR R.CONTENT_RICH IS NOT NULL OR R.PRACTICABILITY IS NOT NULL OR R.TIME_MODERATE IS NOT NULL OR R.ALLSCORE IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY R.STU_EMPID
